name: Bvlgari Hotel Tokyo
positioning: Italian-style luxury hotel on the upper floors of the Tokyo Midtown Yaesu skyscraper, with Japanese design touches
best_for: Travelers who want a central Tokyo base within walking distance of the Imperial Palace, Nihombashi and Ginza
Guests who value dining and spa facilities inside the hotel

facts.text: The hotel occupies the 40th to 45th floors of the Tokyo Midtown Yaesu skyscraper.
The hotel is within walking distance of the Imperial Palace and the shopping areas of Nihombashi and Ginza.
Il Ristorante - Niko Romito is on the 40th floor of the hotel.
Il Ristorante - Niko Romito has both indoor and outdoor seating.
The Bvlgari Spa is on the 40th floor, and its indoor pool sits behind floor to ceiling glass windows with views of the skyline.
Augustinus Bader products and wellness philosophy are available at The Bvlgari Spa.
The spa changing rooms have hot baths and Japanese showers.
The Superior Rooms combine vintage Bvlgari ads and silver Bvlgari candleholders with traditional Japanese design elements.
The Superior Suites feature decor from Italian brands such as Maxalto and B&B and from Japanese wood furniture maker Ritzwell.
The Bvlgari Suite layers a modern Italian aesthetic with touches of Japanese tradition.

highlights.text: Bvlgari Hotel Tokyo was awarded Three MICHELIN Keys in the 2026 MICHELIN Key Hotels, for the third consecutive year.
Sushi Hoseki is a traditional omakase restaurant with 8 seats overlooking a small zen garden.
The Spa Suite has a hydro massage tub clad in Iranian green onyx and treatment beds for two.
Il Ristorante - Niko Romito combines Japanese design elements such as a curved wood ceiling with a classic Niko Romito Italian menu.
The 40th-floor Bvlgari Lounge has a large cast iron and granite fireplace and opens onto the Terrace.

considerations.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito admits guests aged 12 and above, except staying guests of the hotel.
The pool is open to children aged four and above only at set daytime hours, while the Spa and Fitness Center are for guests aged 16 and above.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the premium positioning.
